ratios.quote: As of September 30, 2026, the STG first-out first lien leverage ratio was below 3.5x.

parsed.notes: The covenant is a springing test: it applies only if 35% or more of the $575 million First-Out Revolving Credit Facility is drawn at quarter end. Nothing was drawn at September 30, 2026, so STG was not subject to the covenant on that date. The filing gives no exact actual ratio and says only that it was below 3.5x. The covenant applies to STG, a wholly-owned subsidiary and the borrower under the Credit Agreement.
